sources.title: KDDI FY2027.3 Q1 results briefing (7 August 2026): highlights and Q&A, stating that customers have already adopted the AIDC Sakai DC
sources.capture_note: Captured 2026-10-23 with capture.mjs (HTTP 200, 312,729 bytes, sha256 6677e97d...2521), rehashed against its metadata. Seven-page PDF; PDF CreationDate 2026-08-10. It is linked from KDDI's IR results-briefing library page (captured 2026-10-23 as local kddi-ir-presentation.html, sha256 ce4de263...a0a8; the HTML at byte 32413 labels the entry '2027年3月期第1四半期決算説明会（2026年8月7日）' and links this file at byte 35405). The library page gives no posting date for the PDF, so no publication date is asserted. newsroom.kddi.com returns HTTP 403 to this client and was not retried.
sources.summary: KDDI's own written summary of its 7 August 2026 first-quarter results briefing and Q&A. In answering a question on AI growth investment, management states that companies that have already adopted the AIDC's Sakai DC (AIDC の堺 DC で既に採用した企業) include autonomous-driving companies and other diverse use cases, and that investment targets will be chosen with those fields in mind. The AIDC Sakai DC is KDDI's Osaka Sakai Data Center (KDDI's first AI data centre, opened 22 January 2026). The statement describes customers already using the facility at the time of the briefing; it gives no capacity, utilisation, new building or phase.
sources.date_semantics: 7 August 2026 is the date of the results briefing and Q&A session that the document reports (its header: 日時 2026年8月7日（金）, Q&A 18:00-18:45), and is used as the observation date of the current-adoption statement. The PDF was created on 10 August 2026 and its posting date is unknown, so no publication date is recorded. 7 August is not an opening, completion or capacity-delivery date.

pdf_text_pointers.literal: AIDC の堺 DC で既に採用した企業には自動運転企業など多様なユースケースがあり

sources.title: BroadBand Tower and Hokuden Information Technology joint release (15 October 2026): resale of BroadBand Tower data-centre services from its Ishikari Shinko Site hall inside Ishikari Renewable Energy Data Center No.1
sources.attribution: Hokuden Information Technology Co., Inc.; BroadBand Tower, Inc.
sources.capture_note: Captured 2026-10-23 with the credential-free capture script (HTTP 200, text/html, 13267 bytes, sha256 d220e0bd...3a30) after www.h-ix.jp/robots.txt was recorded at 03:13:43Z (it disallows only /contact/). The page is the co-issuer Hokuden Information Technology's own news page on its H-IX data-centre site; it reproduces the release text and links the formal three-page PDF of the same release (news_202610.pdf, captured 03:14:03Z, HTTP 200, 482780 bytes, sha256 d09523c0...421b, dated 2026年10月15日, issued jointly by 株式会社ブロードバンドタワー and ほくでん情報テクノロジー株式会社). The H-IX top page (hix-top.html, sha256 55dd4861...7e2e) lists the item as '2026.10.15 プレスリリース' at byte 7840. BroadBand Tower's and Hokuden IT's corporate hosts returned HTTP 503 to robots.txt on 2026-10-23, so their copies were not requested.
sources.summary: BroadBand Tower and Hokuden Information Technology (Hokkaido Electric group) announce that from 15 October 2026 Hokuden IT resells the data-centre services (colocation, internet lines and related options) that BroadBand Tower provides in its data hall 石狩新港サイト inside 石狩再エネデータセンター第1号 (Ishikari, Hokkaido), a facility characterised by 100% renewable power; the stated service start for the resale is 15 October 2026, for AI/HPC, disaster-recovery and backup use. BroadBand Tower provides the data-centre service and technical support for equipment and operation; Hokuden IT is the sales window. The release names the facility and the hall in the present tense and gives no capacity, occupancy, new building or phase.
sources.date_semantics: Release dated 2026年10月15日 (byte 5541 of the capture) and listed as 2026.10.15 on the H-IX news index; the resale service start is the same day ('提供開始時期 2026年10月15日', bytes 7759 and 7812). 15 October 2026 is used as a publication-normalised operating observation of the facility through the present-tense statement that BroadBand Tower provides data-centre services inside it from that day. It is not an inspection date, the facility's completion (27 March 2026) or its service start (1 August 2026), and no dateModified is relied on.
